# Status

The historical Node HTTP, server-sent-event, WebSocket, provider, and Python
bridge gateway is retired. It is not a compatibility API and grants no
execution, lifecycle, telemetry-write, intelligence, provider, process, or
filesystem authority.

Every attempted activation returns the exact terminal error:

```text
legacy_gateway_retired_use_cstar_kernel
```

The executable server fails during direct import before dotenv/config access,
Fastify construction, route registration, or socket bind. Route and plugin
modules fail at registration before reading the supplied host. `CognitiveRouter`,
`CorvusProcess`, and `CortexLink` fail at construction before provider, callback,
process, Hall/state, source, or filesystem work.

# Retired source inventory

- `src/node/gateway/server.ts`
- `src/node/gateway/plugins/corvus.ts`
- `src/node/gateway/routes/api/intent.ts`
- `src/node/gateway/routes/api/mimir.ts`
- `src/node/gateway/routes/api/telemetry.ts`
- `src/node/gateway/routes/streams/telemetry.ts`
- `src/node/gateway/routes/ws/events.ts`
- `src/node/core/CognitiveRouter.ts`
- `src/node/core/CorvusProcess.ts`
- `src/node/cortex_link.ts`

There are no supported `/api/intent`, `/api/mimir/*`, gateway telemetry,
gateway SSE, gateway WebSocket, local Ollama, one-shot Python bridge, or
gateway-to-kernel execution routes.

The historical Python intelligence router in `src/core/mimir_client.py` and
`src/core/engine/cognitive_router.py` is separately terminal with:

```text
legacy_python_intelligence_router_retired_use_cstar_kernel
```

It performs no environment/config read, provider selection, subprocess, Hall or
Synapse access, source collection, filesystem mutation, Forge simulation, lease,
learning callback, or CLI fallback.

# Current surfaces

Control-plane planning, lifecycle, Forge/Researcher receipts, validation, and
completion use the direct-stdio `cstar-kernel` MCP documented in
`docs/integrations/cstar-kernel-mcp.md`. PennyOne remains an operator-visible
projection and read-only inspection surface; it is not an execution or
lifecycle gateway. Historical endpoint descriptions under `legacy_archive/`
are evidence only.
